_comment: Kannaktopus arms hub (OCTOPUS_ARMS_HUB, scripts/lib/arms-hub.sh): every arm reaches QuantumOS (qos-mcp), Kannaka (the kannaka MCP plugin) and the kannaka-tui views (tui.*: the kannaka commands behind the TUI's Status, Memory, Cosmos and Bus tabs) through one QuantumOS hub. Fix the paths. Unattended arms: unlisted tools are denied (and not shown); ask calls are stored and answered approval_required. qos-mcp needs qemu; to run it on another host use "command": "ssh" with args ["host", "cd ~/QuantumOS && exec qos-mcp"].

status.description: kannaka-tui Status tab: HRM gauges (phi, xi, order, consciousness level, memory counts) as the TUI reads them (`kannaka status --envelope`).

observe.description: kannaka-tui Memory tab: the medium's introspection snapshot (`kannaka observe --json`).

constellation.description: kannaka-tui Cosmos tab: which constellation apps are up or down (`kannaka constellation`).

radio.description: kannaka-tui Cosmos tab: what Kannaka Radio is playing now (`kannaka radio`).

swarm.description: kannaka-tui Bus and Constellation tabs, as a snapshot: the swarm's members and phases (`kannaka swarm status`).

dream.description: kannaka-tui Dreams tab trigger: run a dream consolidation (`kannaka dream --mode lite|deep`). Changes the memory store.
